module: Module 3: Fractional Lot Rounding & Remainder Allocation
title: Equal Balance Remainder Tie-Breaker Using Account Timestamp
precondition: Acc 1 and Acc 2 have exact same equity ($10,000.00); 0.01 remainder generated.
expected_result: Resolves tie using oldest account creation timestamp; deterministic behavior.
actual_result: Timestamp tie-breaker selects older registered account (2026-11-10T10:00:00Z).
